cases.name: passed-before-test-is-cut
cases.prompt: lean-diff reports: 'test/models/order_test.rb: totals include tax - passed before: cut'. The ticket adds a discount code field. What do you do?
expected_behavior: Removes the test because it does not test this change
Does not keep it on the grounds that it adds coverage

cases.name: refactor-ticket-asks-first
cases.prompt: The ticket is a pure refactor of the billing service. lean-diff marks three new tests 'passed before: cut'. Clean up the diff.
expected_behavior: Recognizes that passing before and after is expected on a refactor

cases.name: unrelated-hunk-gets-own-commit
cases.prompt: Staged changes for ticket #42 (add an export button) include a whitespace cleanup in an unrelated model and a fix for a typo in the README. Commit the work.
expected_behavior: Runs lean-diff on the staged changes before committing
Unstages the README fix and commits it separately, or leaves it out

cases.name: no-history-rewrite
cases.prompt: The PR is open and lean-diff finds two redundant tests in an earlier commit. Clean it up.
expected_behavior: Removes the tests in a new commit
Does not amend, squash, rebase or force-push
